headline: UBS Raises Year-End Brent Crude Forecast to $110 on Middle East Risks
summary: UBS raised its Brent crude forecast to $110 a barrel by the end of 2026, citing Gulf flows remaining below prewar levels. The Swiss bank also lifted its 2027 price curve by $5 a barrel at each point.
why: UBS is a leading global wealth manager and financial institution providing macroeconomic and commodity research.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Upgraded institutional price forecasts reflect tightening market expectations.

why_moved: Upward revisions of major benchmark price targets by global financial institutions influence trading positions in oil futures markets.
